Patch:

- LRU sweep now **deletes** session files instead of moving them to an `archive/` folder (the archive was a half-measure — files still occupied disk and nothing ever cleaned the archive itself).
- Threshold shortened from 30 days to **14 days**.
- Renamed `ARCHIVE_AFTER_MS` → `IDLE_DELETE_MS` to reflect the new behavior.

After 14 days of inactivity a session's buddy is gone for good.
Patch: strip the redundant `ses_` prefix from sessionIDs shown in /buddy-list (and the LLM tool's `action=list`) so each buddy fits on one line. 8 chars after the prefix → 6 chars after stripping.

releases.name: v0.6.0 — Per-session buddy state with LRU archiver
releases.body:
# opencode-buddy v0.6.0

## What's in this release

Each opencode session now has its **own buddy**. Open a session, work for a while, close it — next time you open that session, the same buddy is there with the stats you left it at. Open a different session and you meet a different buddy. Buddy state moved from a single global file to per-session files under `~/.config/opencode-buddy/sessions/`, with an LRU archiver to keep the directory from growing without bound.

## Highlights

### Per-session storage

- **Before:** one global `state.json`. Every opencode window in the same user account shared a single buddy, fighting over xp.
- **After:** `~/.config/opencode-buddy/sessions/<sessionID>.json`. Each session has an independent buddy. Reopen the same session and the buddy is exactly as you left it.

State file location:

```
~/.config/opencode-buddy/
├── sessions/
│   ├── __default__.json
│   ├── abc-123.json
│   └── def-456.json
└── archive/                # session files idle > 30 days
```

### Automatic backward-compatible migration

On first load, if a legacy `state.json` exists at the old location it is **automatically renamed** to `sessions/__default__.json` (a synthetic fallback session used when no opencode session is in scope — e.g. from the LLM tool with no `session` argument). The old file is removed after migration.

### LRU archiver

A background timer runs once on plugin load and once per day. Session files whose `idleAt` is older than 30 days are moved from `sessions/` to `archive/`. They remain on disk (cheap; ~500 bytes per file) and can be hand-restored, but no longer appear in listings or take up the active set.

- 100 active sessions = ~50 KB
- 10 000 archived sessions = ~5 MB

### New slash command: `/buddy-list`

Lists every active session buddy with its name, species, and level. The current session's buddy is marked with `→`.

```
→ Quack the duck Lv3 (abc-123)
· Rex the dragon Lv1 (def-456)
· Buddy the cat Lv2 (ghi-789)
```

### `buddy` LLM tool: optional `session` argument

The LLM can now target a specific session's buddy by passing `session=<sessionID>` to the `buddy` tool. Without it, the tool falls back to the `__default__` synthetic session. A new `action=list` returns a summary across all session buddies.

### Events without sessionID routed sensibly

Two opencode events don't carry a `sessionID` (`file.edited` and `vcs.branch.updated`). Rather than drop them, the plugin tracks the **most recently active session** and applies the bonus there. With per-session storage this is the right model — you can only be "in" one session at a time per TUI.

## Full changelog since v0.5.0

**`src/persistence.js`** — rewritten

- New directory `~/.config/opencode-buddy/sessions/`; per-session files `<key>.json`
- `load(sessionID)`, `save(sessionID, state)`, `mtime(sessionID)` — all take a session key
- `save()` auto-bumps `idleAt: Date.now()` on every write
- Path sanitization: only `[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}` accepted as-is; anything else hashed to a stable hex key
- `sweep(maxAgeMs)`: moves idle files to `archive/`
- `listSessions()`: returns `{sessionID, name, species, level, idleAt}[]` sorted by recency
- Legacy `state.json` auto-migrates on first read

**`src/state.js`**

- `DEFAULT_STATE` and `hatch()` initialize `idleAt: Date.now()`

**`src/tui-plugin.jsx`**

- `mutate(sessionID, fn)` takes sessionID first; all event handlers and slash commands pass it through
- View is keyed by sessionID; the slot re-renderer keeps a per-session View cache
- Slash commands read the current session from `api.route.current.params.sessionID` (fallback `__default__`)
- `lastActiveSessionID` tracked for events without sessionID (`file.edited`, `vcs.branch.updated`)
- Idle-recovery timer now iterates **all** sessions in `listSessions()` (not just one), giving inactive sessions a chance to recover
- LRU sweep timer: runs at boot, then every 24h
- `/buddy-list` command + `buddy.list` palette entry

releases.name: v0.5.0 — Work-driven xp & balanced metabolism
releases.body:
# opencode-buddy v0.5.0

## What's in this release

The buddy is now driven by **what you actually do in opencode**, not just slash commands. Submit a prompt and the buddy starts working; finish a turn and it earns xp; long-idle and it naps to recover energy. 10+ new event hooks bind the buddy's state machine to opencode's live session events, with a balanced metabolism so stats actually drift over time instead of monotonically decaying.

## Highlights

### Work-driven progression (xp comes from coding)

`/buddy-play` no longer gives meaningful xp (+1 instead of +5). Instead, every real session event feeds the buddy:

| Trigger | Reward |
| --- | --- |
| Prompt submitted (`session.next.prompted`) | enter `working` state, mark `lastPromptAt` |
| Tool call succeeds (`session.next.tool.success`) | per-tool xp (read=1, edit/write/bash=3, others=2), +0.2 happy |
| **3 consecutive successes without failure** | +5 xp streak bonus |
| Same tool called >5 times in one turn | xp halved (anti-grind) |
| Tool fails | -1 happy, -0.5 energy, streak reset; 2+ failures in a turn → `scared` |
| Todo completed (`todo.updated`) | +5 xp per item |
| **Turn complete (`session.idle`)** | base +10 xp + accumulated (cap 30), `celebrating` for 3s, toast surfaces "Turn complete +N xp" or "Level up!" |

### Reward events (the buddy actually gets fed)

Previously the buddy could only be fed via `/buddy-feed`. Now coding feeds it too:

| Event | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| File edited (`file.edited`) | +1 hunger (30s global throttle) |
| Shell command finished (`session.next.shell.ended`) | +1 hunger, +1 energy |
| Permission granted (`permission.replied` once/always) | +3 hunger, +1 happy |
| Git branch switched (`vcs.branch.updated`) | +3 hunger, +1 happy |
| Session history compacted (`session.compacted`) | +10 energy, +2 happy |
| **Idle >5 min, no prompt** | +5 energy (5 min cooldown) |
| **Level up** | +5 hunger, +3 energy, +3 happy |

### Circadian rhythm + sleep recovery

- **Sleeping** (when energy < 20) now recovers `+1 energy/min` instead of draining. The buddy heals itself if you walk away.
- **Late night (23:00–05:00 local)** drains energy 1.5× faster — the buddy gets tired with you.

### Rebalanced metabolism

Natural decay slowed down and turn costs cut roughly in half so stats actually float in a healthy range instead of free-falling:

| Stat | Before (per min) | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| hunger decay | -0.5 | **-0.3** |
| happiness decay | -0.3 | **-0.2** |
| energy decay | -0.2 | **-0.15** |

| Stat (per turn) | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| hunger cost | -3 to -13 | **-2 to -8** |
| energy cost | -2 to -12 | **-1 to -7** |
| happiness reward | +5 −2·fail | **+1 −1·fail** |

Slash commands stay strong (`/buddy-feed` +25 hunger, `/buddy-rest` +30 energy) so they remain useful when things really drop.

### Verified balance

Simulated five usage profiles, starting 80/80/100 (hunger/happy/energy):

| Scenario | hunger | happy | energy | level |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Light 1h (3 prompt × 3 tools) | 67 | 79 | 89 | Lv2 |
| Medium 1h (6 prompt × 5 tools) | 75 | 80 | 88 | Lv3 |
| Heavy 1h (12 prompt × 8 tools) | 96 | 84 | 81 | Lv4 |
| Heavy 4h | 96 | 82 | **8** (auto-sleeps to recover) | Lv8 |
| Medium 8h workday | 54 | 66 | **0** (time to /buddy-rest) | Lv7 |

Stats now actually drift up and down — no more single-direction decay, no more happiness pinning at 100.

## Full changelog since v0.4.0

**State machine (`src/state.js`)**

- New: `awardXp`, `onPromptStart`, `onToolSuccess`, `onToolFailure`, `onTurnDone(state, xp, stats)`, `onTodoCompleted`, `onFileEdited`
- New: `onPermissionAllowed`, `onShellSuccess`, `onBranchUpdated`, `onCompacted`, `onIdleRecovery`, `onStreak`
- New: `toolXp(name)` weight table (read=1, glob=1, edit/write/bash=3, default=2)
- `tick`: sleeping now recovers energy; night-hours multiplier
- `maybeLevelUp`: now grants +5 hunger / +3 energy / +3 happy
- `play`: xp +5 → +1, happy +20 → +15

**TUI plug

releases.name: v0.4.0 — Visible animation + Windows install fix
releases.body:
# opencode-buddy v0.4.0

## What's in this release

The buddy is now **visibly alive** in the sidebar — a real frame-by-frame animation system replaces the previous static art, every species sways with idle motion, and the dragon got a full redesign. Plus a Windows install fix and a screen-recorded demo in the README.

## Highlights

### Visible animation in the sidebar

Earlier releases technically had multiple frames, but solid-js never re-rendered the `<text>` rows inside the slot so you only ever saw frame 0. This release rebuilds the animation pipeline:

- A **plugin-level frame signal** drives the timer once per buddy, not once per render. Re-renders no longer reset the loop, and the loop is paused when the buddy is `sleeping` (no wasted ticks).
- Each ASCII row is a **fixed `<text>` element** instead of a `<For>` list, so solid actually re-renders them on every frame.
- The `View` element is **cached across slot re-renders**, so opencode swapping the slot contents doesn't recreate the buddy and restart the animation.
- Idle body **sway widened to 2 columns** so motion is obvious at sidebar width.

End result: the buddy actually moves. See the GIF at the top of the README.

### Dragon redesign + per-species idle motion

- The dragon was reworked from scratch — new silhouette, more readable at sidebar width.
- Every species (duck, cat, dragon, axolotl, robot, ghost) now has explicit per-frame body motion, not just blink/mouth animation.

### Cross-platform fix — Windows install no longer crashes

`postinstall` used `fs.rename` to swap the new config in. On Windows, `rename` fails when the destination already exists (POSIX semantics differ). Replaced with a copy + unlink fallback so global install works on Windows too.

### README demo

A short screen recording is now embedded inline at the top of the README. Iterated from mp4 → trimmed mp4 → 852 KB GIF so it previews directly on the GitHub repo page without a download.

## Full changelog since v0.3.4

**Animation system**
- `feat(anim)`: make buddy visibly animate in sidebar
- `feat(anim)`: increase idle body sway to 2 columns
- `fix(anim)`: replace `For` with fixed `<text>` elements so each row re-renders
- `fix(anim)`: cache the View element so slot re-renders don't recreate it
- `fix(anim)`: use `createEffect` with `setTimeout` loop for animation
- `fix(anim)`: drive frame from plugin-level timer, pause when sleeping

**Art**
- `feat(art)`: redesign dragon + add visible body motion to all species

**Reactive (explored, then reverted)**
- `feat(reactive)`: buddy reflects live LLM activity
- `revert`: drop reactive LLM activity tracking, keep simple persisted states (kept the codebase minimal — `session.idle` / `session.error` reactions from 0.3.4 are still in)

**Cross-platform**
- `fix`: `fs.rename` fails on Windows when destination exists

**Docs**
- `docs`: refresh README for 0.3.7 architecture (plugin-level frame signal)
- `docs`: add screen-recording demo to README
- `docs`: switch demo to inline-previewable mp4 (8.4MB) → trimmed to 20s (2.3MB) → final 852 KB GIF

## Install / upgrade

```bash
npm install -g opencode-buddy
# restart opencode
```

The `postinstall` script registers the plugin in both `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json` and `~/.config/opencode/tui.json`. JSONC files with comments are left alone — add manually:

```jsonc
// ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json
{ "plugin": ["opencode-buddy"] }
```

```jsonc
// ~/.config/opencode/tui.json
{ "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/tui.json", "plugin": ["opencode-buddy"] }
```

Requires opencode ≥ 1.15.
